pool_spot_price_manipulated.meaning: the Uniswap V2 pool spot price has been manipulated away from its unmanipulated value before buyBack() is called

flash_loan_obtained.meaning: attacker has obtained flash-loaned tokens usable to manipulate the pool price

swap_executed_at_unfavorable_rate.meaning: the swap performed by BuyBackBurner executes at a rate unfavorable to the protocol relative to the unmanipulated price

slippage_protection_effective.meaning: validatePrice() computes a TWAP distinct from the current spot price so that slippage protection in BuyBackBurner._buyOLAS() rejects swaps when the price deviates beyond maxSlippage
slippage_protection_effective.checkpoint: at validatePrice() evaluation before the swap

assumptions: Attacker is able to call buyBack() on BuyBackBurner (permissionlessness not established in report).
The flash-loan and pool-manipulation steps are an attack narrative, not observed transactions.
The swap under consideration is the one performed by BuyBackBurner._buyOLAS() after validatePrice().

unresolved.description: Report does not give numeric TWAP, spot price, maxSlippage, or swap-rate quantities, so the TWAP-distinct-from-spot relation and the unfavorable-rate relation are represented as grounded Booleans rather than numeric comparisons.
Report does not state whether buyBack() is permissionless or restricted, so attacker access to trigger the swap is not established.

limitations: Only the swap_unfavorable impact is formalized; validatePrice() always-true and protocol fund loss are separate impacts not covered by this plan.
The TWAP-distinct-from-spot and unfavorable-rate conditions are qualitative in the report and lack numeric operands; later code binding must supply the concrete price comparison.
